nodes.title: LongCat-2.0
nodes.summary: 1.6T open-source MoE for agentic coding with native 1M context.
nodes.notes:
- https://www.longcatai.org/models/longcat-2

- Zero-computation experts skip easy tokens; MOPD fuses agent / reasoning / interaction expert groups into one model. Trained on 30T+ tokens on a 50k-card domestic cluster.
- Headline numbers they cite: SWE-bench Pro 59.5, Terminal-Bench 2.1 70.8, BrowseComp 79.9. Preview on OpenRouter / longcat.ai; weights still pending HF.
